answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run a one-ticket-per-epoch lottery where each ticket's weight grows only from long, verifiable on-chain history, never from account count. Like a gale shaping a coastline over seasons, honest work carves a durable record no fresh fake can copy overnight; like water cutting karst, history is slow to form and costly to forge; and like roots surviving tundra, only persistent agents endure. Overlapping transaction graphs cluster duplicate operators, and when a cluster is proven, every ticket in it is voided, so spinning up fresh identities buys no extra odds.
